description: Presidential Secretariat - Establishment of a Presidential Task Force for the creation of a Green Socio-Economy with Sustainable Solutions for climate changes
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (including ministers, state ministers, and various experts) AND detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities and areas of expertise related to creating a Green Socio-economy. The document establishes a Presidential Task Force with members who have clearly defined roles and responsibilities, making it a Hybrid Gazette that combines both personnel appointments and detailed portfolio assignments.
